track: The River of Renewal IV - Integration
voice_direction: mature male, warm, low, unhurried, near-monotone, intimate; speed ~0.85; let ellipses breathe

segments.text: This program is a relaxation and healing visualization... created for rest, and personal growth. It is not a medical treatment... and it never replaces the care of your doctors. Never listen in a moving vehicle... or at any time when you need your full, awakened attention.

This is the integration track... a few quiet minutes... for the daytime you. No deep rest today... just a settling... and a remembering. Sit somewhere comfortable... keep your eyes soft... and let these few minutes... belong entirely... to you.
Take one slow breath in... and let it go. And another... deeper this time... and as it leaves... feel your shoulders drop... just a little... and your eyes grow soft.
You know the way now. The night river... the lantern boats... the warm banks... it is all there... only one breath away. Take that breath... and stand on the bank.

The river is quiet in the daylight... and it is still yours. And there on the bank... someone has left you something... a simple cup... of clear water... catching the light. Pick it up... feel it cool in your hand. This water... is the whole river... folded small.
In the days to come... every time you drink... a glass of water... a cup of tea... you will remember... the river... and the whole night of quiet repair... will return to you... in a single sip.
And whenever you take one slow breath... before a meal... before a conversation... before bed... you will feel the current... moving quietly... beneath everything.
You may notice your hands... warming... at odd moments of the day. That is only the river... arriving... where it is needed.
When your body asks for rest... you will hear it sooner... and answer it kinder. A body asking for care... is a lantern... hung by the door.
And you will protect one quiet hour... the way the river keeps its course. Not because anyone tells you to. Because it is yours... and you know... what flows there.
Each night... without effort... the watch patrols... the weavers weave... and you will wake... a little more renewed... than you went to sleep.
Perhaps you will find yourself drinking more water now... not as a rule... as a remembering. Each glass... a small tide... coming in.
And through it all... you are not becoming someone else. You are keeping company... with what you already are. The flow... the clearing... the renewing. It is your nature.
And now... set the cup back down on the bank... where it will wait for you. Feel the chair beneath you... the room around you... the day... waiting.
Take one deeper breath... and as you let it go... feel yourself arriving... clear... awake... quietly watered... and well.
And when you are ready... open your eyes... and step back into your day... carrying the river with you. For you are... the river... ever renewing... and your body... remembers the way.
